reason: User explicitly asks during design, before any new model fit, to investigate the accuracy ceiling and underdog success rather than aggregate accuracy alone
feature_addendum: Add a third outcome-free gating feature: market maximum probability minus market probability of the unique top tipster direction. It is zero for agreement, positive for a lower-market-probability direction. Retain entropy and normalized JS features. No underdog bonus, price cutoff or outcome reweighting.
evaluation: For every comparator and candidate report favorite/top-tie/underdog selection counts, selection share, hit rate, original-price ROI, mean predicted and market probability of chosen side; same-fixture market wins/ROI within each model's underdog selection subset; per-league and market rank. Selection groups differ across models, so group ROI is not a causal head-to-head ranking.
ceiling_diagnostic: Count events whose four component vectors have the same unique argmax and that unanimous direction is wrong. Any nonnegative convex mixture of these FIXED vectors must choose that same unique direction; reweighting cannot correct those events. Report all-model agreement/error intersections. Do not call the complementary fraction achievable accuracy or an oracle performance estimate. Not a ceiling for future models with new inputs.
selection_rule_unchanged: Select solely June available-label logloss with fixed seven candidates; all July-October outcomes stay excluded from fits/selection. Underdog metrics and error intersection are descriptive diagnostics after forecasts. No post-hoc tuning from those results.
scope: Same reused retrospective445/122 with no certified source/price receipt; not new prospective validation or model adoption
